answers.how: Tracked head positions around 1.0 s: black-shirt motion was about 127 px/s versus 163 px/s for the white shirt. Speed = 1.3 × 127/163.
At 1.0 s, the head centers were about 669 px apart. The white shirt's motion gives a scale of 1.3/163 meters per pixel.
At 2.0 s, the head centers were about 382 px apart. Distance = 382 × 1.3/163.
